# Offshoots

> Interactive map of North American music styles: trace what any style grew out of and what grew out of it. Built for the School of Listening class.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/bryanbell/Offshoots): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
